# DevMesh v1.0.2

Patch release focused on discoverability and self-contained downloads.

## Changes

- Added configuration-free `--version` / `-V` CLI output.
- Synchronized the CLI, TUI, JAR manifest, and release version at `1.0.2`.
- Added platform-specific Java 21 runtime bundles to the release assets.
- Kept the existing `devmesh.jar` artifact and runtime behavior unchanged.

## Downloads

Download `devmesh.jar` and the Java 21 runtime bundle matching your platform. The Linux x64 bundle is uploaded in this release; Windows and macOS bundles are configured in the release workflow and require Actions permission to run:

- `devmesh-jdk21-linux-x64.tar.gz`
- `devmesh-jdk21-windows-x64.zip`
- `devmesh-jdk21-macos-x64.tar.gz`

The runtime bundles are generated with `jlink` and contain the modules required to run DevMesh.

## Validation

- `./gradlew clean test engineeringValidation shadowJar`
- `java -jar devmesh.jar --version`
- Java 21 runtime bundles built on Linux, Windows, and macOS runners.
